I sent Dana the list in our DM. Moss's notes have two Quarrendon Freight Lines (QFL) ticket numbers:

- **#PD-4492**: from "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth" (`teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md`). Thea Ramaswell filed it on 4 Oct 2025. Drivers at the Eau Claire yard weren't getting SMS bay assignments from the gatehouse kiosk at Dock Doors 14–18. Support patched it that evening, and Thea confirmed the next morning's 04:00 shift had no problems.
- **#4419**: from "Moss: North cheat sheet (undated)" (`teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md`). Thea logged it because the gatehouse barcode scanners weren't reading trailer tags at Door 14 on third shift. It was escalated to tier-2 support for scanner firmware testing. The note has no date, so I can't tell whether it's still open.

I checked all six of Moss's notes in the shared files: four North and two Central. Two others mention QFL but give no ticket number: the 14 Sep 2025 North pipeline digest and the 23 Mar 2026 renewal check-in. #4409 and #4412 in the Central handoffs digest belong to Marrow Fieldworks, not QFL. The cheat sheet also warns not to mix QFL up with Quarendon Freightways, which isn't a customer.

I only used files and channels Dana can see herself. The knowledge base turned up two more QFL ticket numbers, #4912 and #8841, but I left both out. Neither comes from Moss's notes, and I couldn't confirm Dana can see where #4912 comes from.
